text:
Kai: Tiny poll for the culture book: if Redwood had a single unofficial emoji mascot in Slack, which one should it be? pick one and defend it in 1 sentence. :grinning:
Lena: :rocket: because we ship fast and it's aspirational. short defense: boosts morale in threads.
Omar: :gear: the ops vibe, quietly keeps everything moving. also looks cool in docs.
Zoe: :seedling: growth, green, low-key wholesome. plus it's photogenic.
Ravi: :brain: for inference brains. nerd flex, also good for PRs that actually earn the tag.
Kai: ops-bot, make it a react-to-vote poll please. :slightly_smiling_face:
ops-bot: Poll created 2options: :rocket: / :gear: / :seedling: / :brain:. React to vote.
Lena: Voted :rocket:. also if we pick :seedling: we need a tiny plant emoji for the office merch.
Omar: Leaning :gear: but secretly want :brain: to win so I can spam it on infrastructure threads.
Zoe: I voted :seedling: and I will bring a real plant to the next offsite as reinforcement. :herb:
Ravi: :brain: cast. also proposing a brief celebration GIF if :rocket: wins.
Kai: Tally so far: :rocket: and :seedling: neck and neck. decision postponed to Friday coffee meeting. Thanks team for the hot takes. :coffee:
